name: navra-capture-extension
description: Navra Capture Browser Extension for NavraCar

scripts.build: npm run build:staging && npm run build:production
scripts.build:staging: npm run bundle && cd dist/staging && zip -r ../navra-capture-staging.zip .
scripts.build:production: npm run bundle && cd dist/production && zip -r ../navra-capture-production.zip .
scripts.dev: npm run bundle && echo 'Extension bundled. Load from dist/staging'

author: Navra
